name: s7-claude-dashboards
label: EXAMPLE · AI STAND-IN VOICE · NO FACE

lines.say: Claude can now build a live dashboard straight from your Databricks data, and you never write the query.
It's called Claude Dashboards. It came out on October 8th, and it's in beta on paid plans.
Step one: connect your data. Sources include Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift and ClickHouse.
lines.title: CONNECT YOUR DATA

lines.say: Step two: ask in plain English. Something like, how did this month's pipeline compare to last month?
lines.title: ASK IN PLAIN ENGLISH

lines.say: Claude writes the query and builds the dashboard.
lines.show: Claude *writes the query*. And builds the dashboard.

lines.say: Step three: it stays current as your data changes.
lines.title: IT STAYS CURRENT

lines.say: And this is the part I'd show your boss. Click any number, and it shows you the query behind it. Every chart also shows when it last refreshed.
lines.show: Click any number: *the query behind it*. Every chart: when it last refreshed.

lines.say: Two catches. Power BI isn't on the list of tools you can send it to. And on Enterprise plans, it's off until your admin turns it on.
lines.show: Catches: *no Power BI* export. Enterprise: *off until an admin turns it on*.

lines.say: Comment DASH and I'll send you my setup checklist.
